title: Which Numbers Up to 50 Are Prime
description: Sieving out multiples to reveal every prime number under 50.
narration_lines: Which numbers up to 50 are actually prime?
Start crossing out every multiple of 2, then 3, then 5, then 7.
Whatever survives the sieve can't be divided evenly by anything smaller.
What's left are the primes -- each one has exactly two factors: 1 and itself.
